content.title: SpaceX Wins $2 Billion Contract For Golden Dome
content.summary: SpaceX secured a $2 billion government contract for satellites meant to track incoming missiles and planes as part of President Donald Trump's desire to build a national U.S. air defense system, according to the Wall Street Journal.  The project, dubbed the Golden Dome, emulates Israel's Iron Dome initiative that intercepts enemy rockets in midair before they reach their targets on the ground.  Initial plans for the Golden Dome include a system of 600 satellites, the Wall Street Journal reported.
